particular.configuration.title: Particular Configuration
particular.configuration.waterSplash.too: Enable water splash particles when entities hit water
particular.configuration.cascades.toolti: Enable cascade particles for flowing water
particular.configuration.cascadeMist.too: Enable the translucent mist that drifts off cascades
Enable spray particles at the bottom of waterfalls
particular.configuration.fireflies.toolt: Enable firefly particles in suitable biomes at night
particular.configuration.caveDust.toolti: Enable floating dust particles in caves
particular.configuration.chestBubbles.to: Enable bubbles rising from underwater chests
particular.configuration.soulSandBubbles: Enable bubbles rising from soul sand underwater
particular.configuration.barrelBubbles.t: Enable bubbles rising from underwater barrels
Enable bubble popping effects at the water surface
particular.configuration.rainRipples.too:
Enable ripple effects when rain hits water

Automatically disabled when shaders are active
particular.configuration.waterDripRipple:
Enable ripple effects when water drips onto water surfaces

Automatically disabled when shaders are active
particular.configuration.lavaSplash.tool: Enable lava splash particles when entities hit lava
particular.configuration.sableSplashes.t:
Enable water splash and wake particles for Sable sub-levels (ships, boats, vehicles)

Only applies when Sable is installed
particular.configuration.leafSnow.toolti: Enable snow falling off leaves that have snow on top or while it is snowing
particular.configuration.coldBreath.tool: Enable visible breath from players and mobs in cold places
particular.configuration.footstepDust.to: Kick up dust when running or landing on loose ground such as sand, dirt, gravel and snow
particular.configuration.pollen.tooltip: Pollen drifts off flowers during the day
particular.configuration.spores.tooltip: Spores drift off moss and mushrooms
particular.configuration.embers.tooltip: Glowing embers rise from campfires and spit from lit furnaces
particular.configuration.tumbleweeds.too: Bushes tumble across dry sandy biomes
particular.configuration.rainbows.toolti: A rainbow appears in the sky after it stops raining during the day
particular.configuration.updateNotice.to: Show a one-time chat message listing the effects added by an update when you open a world that existed before it
particular.configuration.screenShake.too: Shake the camera for loud nearby sounds such as explosions and Warden roars
particular.configuration.startTime.toolt:
Game time when fireflies begin spawning (in ticks)

12000 = sunset (6:00 PM)
Range: 0 to 23999
particular.configuration.endTime.tooltip:
Game time when fireflies stop spawning (in ticks)

23000 = late night (11:00 PM)
Range: 0 to 23999
particular.configuration.minTemp.tooltip:
Minimum biome temperature for fireflies to spawn

0.5 = temperate climate
Range: 0.0 to 2.0
particular.configuration.maxTemp.tooltip:
Maximum biome temperature for fireflies to spawn

0.99 = warm but not hot
Range: 0.0 to 2.0
Allow fireflies to spawn during rainy weather

Fireflies typically hide during rain
particular.configuration.dailyRandom.too:
Random factors affecting firefly spawn rates throughout the day

List of values representing spawn probability at different times
particular.configuration.grass.tooltip:
Spawn frequency modifier near grass blocks

Range: 0.0 to 1.0
particular.configuration.tallGrass.toolt:
Spawn frequency modifier near tall grass

Range: 0.0 to 1.0
particular.configuration.flowers.tooltip:
Spawn frequency modifier near flowers

Range: 0.0 to 1.0
particular.configuration.tallFlowers.too:
Spawn frequency modifier near tall flowers

Range: 0.0 to 1.0
particular.configuration.spawnChance.too:
Inverse spawn chance

Higher values = less frequent spawning
particular.configuration.spawnRipples.to: Create ripple effects when leaves land on water
particular.configuration.layFlatOnGround: Make leaves lay flat when they land on the ground
particular.configuration.layFlatRightAng: Snap leaf rotation to 90-degree angles when laying flat
particular.configuration.baseMaxAge.tool:
Base lifetime of cave dust particles in ticks

200 ticks = 10 seconds
particular.configuration.color.tooltip:
RGB color value for cave dust particles

0x808080 = gray
Range: 0x000000 to 0xFFFFFF
particular.configuration.fadeDuration.to:
How long dust particles take to fade out in ticks

20 ticks = 1 second
particular.configuration.maxAcceleration:
Maximum acceleration for dust particle movement

Range: 0.0 to 1.0
particular.configuration.accelChangeChan:
Inverse chance of changing dust particle acceleration

Higher values = less frequent changes
180 means 1 in 180 chance per tick
particular.configuration.excludeBiomes.t:
List of biome IDs where cave dust will not spawn

Format: minecraft:biome_name
Toggle various particle effects on or off
particular.configuration.fireflySettings: Configure firefly spawning conditions and behavior
particular.configuration.frequencyModifi: Control how often fireflies spawn near different plants
particular.configuration.leafSnowSetting: Configure how often snow falls off leaves
particular.configuration.coldBreathSetti: Configure who breathes visibly in the cold
particular.configuration.firstPersonBrea: See your own breath in first person
particular.configuration.mobBreath.toolt:
Mobs breathe visibly as well as players

Undead, golems and water creatures never do
particular.configuration.pollenAndSporeS: Configure how much pollen and how many spores are released
particular.configuration.pollenFrequency:
Chance for a flower to release pollen each time it is ticked

Range: 0.0 to 1.0
Chance for a moss block to release a spore each time it is ticked

Range: 0.0 to 1.0
particular.configuration.mushroomSporeFr:
Chance for a mushroom to release a spore each time it is ticked

Range: 0.0 to 1.0
particular.configuration.lushCaveSporeCh:
Inverse chance of a spore appearing in open air in lush caves

Higher values = fewer spores
particular.configuration.emberSettings.t: Configure which blocks give off embers and how many
Lit campfires and soul campfires give off embers
particular.configuration.furnaceEmbers.t: Lit furnaces, blast furnaces and smokers spit embers
particular.configuration.emberAmount.too:
Multiplier for the number of embers

Range: 0.0 to 3.0
particular.configuration.rainbowSettings: Configure how often rainbows appear, how long they last and how strong they are
particular.configuration.rainbowDuration:
How long a rainbow stays in the sky, in seconds

Range: 10 to 3600
particular.configuration.rainbowChance.t:
Chance for a rainbow to appear when rain stops

Range: 0.0 to 1.0
Opacity of the rainbow

Range: 0.0 to 1.0
particular.configuration.tumbleweedSetti: Configure where, how often and how tumbling bushes move
particular.configuration.tumbleweedFrequ:
Chance per tick for a tumbling bush to appear near you in a dry sandy biome

Range: 0.0 to 1.0
particular.configuration.stormBoost.tool:
Multiplier for the chance while the weather is stormy

Range: 1.0 to 50.0
particular.configuration.stormsOnly.tool: Tumbling bushes only appear while the weather is stormy
particular.configuration.groundTag.toolt: Block tag the ground must have for tumbling bushes to appear
particular.configuration.bounciness.tool: How high tumbling bushes bounce off the ground
particular.configuration.footstepDustSet: Configure who kicks up dust and on which blocks
particular.configuration.mobDust.tooltip: Mobs kick up dust as well as players
particular.configuration.replaceSprintPa: Dust replaces the vanilla block chips thrown up when sprinting on dusty blocks
particular.configuration.replaceLandingP: Dust replaces the vanilla block chips thrown up when landing from a fall on dusty blocks
particular.configuration.dustBlocks.tool:
Blocks that produce footstep dust

Use a block id or a #tag
Example: minecraft:gravel, #minecraft:sand
particular.configuration.screenShakeSett: Configure which sounds shake the camera and how strongly
Multiplier for the strength of all camera shake

0.0 = no shake
Range: 0.0 to 3.0
particular.configuration.shakeSounds.too:
Sounds that shake the camera

Format: soundId|intensity|durationTicks|radius
Example: minecraft:entity.generic.explode|0.8|12|16
particular.configuration.heightScaling.t:
Cascades get stronger the further the water falls

When disabled every cascade uses normal intensity
particular.configuration.minIntensity.to:
Cascade intensity for a 1 block fall

1.0 = normal
Range: 0.0 to 5.0
particular.configuration.maxIntensity.to:
Cascade intensity once the fall reaches Max Fall Height

1.0 = normal
Range: 0.0 to 5.0
particular.configuration.maxFallHeight.t:
Fall height (in blocks) at which a cascade reaches its maximum intensity

Range: 1 to 64
particular.configuration.foamDensity.too:
Multiplier for the amount of cascade foam

Range: 0.1 to 4.0
particular.configuration.puffSize.toolti:
Multiplier for the size of cascade foam puffs

Range: 0.25 to 4.0
particular.configuration.mistDensity.too:
Multiplier for the amount of cascade mist

Range: 0.0 to 2.0
particular.configuration.minFallDistance:
Minimum distance (in blocks) an entity must fall before creating water splash particles

0.0 = always create splashes
Range: 0.0 to 100.0
particular.configuration.smallDroplets.t:
Enable water droplet particles for small splashes

Adds visual detail to gentle water entries
particular.configuration.splashOpacity.t:
Opacity of water and lava splash particles

0.75 = 25% more transparent
Range: 0.0 to 1.0
particular.configuration.softEntryPartic: Use bubbles and tiny falling-water droplets for gentle water entries instead of full splash particles
particular.configuration.cuboidWaterfall: Use 1-voxel cuboid particles for waterfall spray
particular.configuration.cuboidSplashDro: Use 1-voxel cuboid particles for splash droplets
particular.configuration.waterCuboidBiom: Tint cuboid waterfall spray using the local biome water color
particular.configuration.waterCuboidColo:
Fallback RGB color for cuboid waterfall spray when biome tinting is disabled

0xFFFFFF = white
Range: 0x000000 to 0xFFFFFF
particular.configuration.lavaCuboidColor:
RGB color for cuboid lava droplets

0xFF681F = orange lava
Range: 0x000000 to 0xFFFFFF
particular.notice.1_6_0: [Particular] 1.6.0 adds new effects: leaf snow, cold breath, footstep dust, pollen, spores, embers, tumbling bushes, rainbows, cascade mist and screen shake. If you see one of these twice, another mod or resource pack adds it too, and you can turn ours off in the Particular config. This message won't show again in this world.
